Application Data.NAME: Luminous Lighting Solutions Inc.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Luminous Lighting Solutions Inc. specializes in the retail sale of a wide range of lighting fixtures and supplies, including residential and commercial lighting products, decorative fixtures, bulbs, and related accessories. Our operations are primarily focused on providing high-quality products through our well-established physical storefront located in Springfield, IL. We ensure rigorous inventory management controls with regular cycle counts and secured storage areas, contributing to a stable operation. We limit on-site installation services to less than 10% of total revenue, focusing primarily on retail sales. Our commitment to quality and customer service enhances our reputation in the market while minimizing associated risks.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 06/15/2022, a theft incident occurred at our Springfield storefront, resulting in the loss of inventory valued at $5,000. The stolen items included various decorative lighting fixtures and LED bulbs. The claim was reported to the police and is currently under investigation. The loss has been recorded and adjustments to our security measures have been made to prevent future incidents. Status: Claim in progress.
Application Data.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: UL Listed Safe, Class B, Grade 1, Fire-Resistant, Security Rated
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Central station alarm system, secured storage areas, regular inventory audits, and on-site security personnel.
